messages:
alex: quick sync — deployed a tiny staging lambda that reads API_KEY from env (set via terraform). curl to our hosted endpoint keeps returning 401. header shows an Authorization: Basic <...> that decodes to what I expect, but the server rejects it. i'm testing locally with the same env value and sometimes when i echo it i see weird output. could this be a trailing NUL or encoding issue from windows/wsl? i'm using the ruby client in this service. any quick checks?

maria.dev: can you hexdump the value?
printf '%s' \"$API_KEY\" | hexdump -C
or
printf '%s' \"$API_KEY\" | xxd
if you see 00 bytes at the end that's a NUL, 0d 0a is CRLF, etc.

sam_c: also watch out for how you're base64'ing in ruby — Base64.encode64 adds newlines by default which can bork headers. use Base64.strict_encode64. example: 
```ruby
req['Authorization'] = 'Basic ' + Base64.strict_encode64(":#{ENV['API_KEY']}")
```
that avoids the trailing \"\n\" at the end of the encoded blob.

alex: ah interesting — i was doing Base64.encode64 blindly in a helper. didn't realize it added a newline. i'll swap to strict_encode64.

eng-infra: minor extra checks: if the secret comes from windows notepad/powershell it can be UTF-16 or include a BOM/NUL. run `file -bi secret.txt` or `xxd` to inspect. if it's UTF-16 you can convert: `iconv -f utf-16 -t utf-8 secret.txt > secret.utf8`

maria.dev: and when you're constructing the header from shell/ci, trim newlines: 
`AUTH_HEADER=$(printf '%s' "$API_KEY" | tr -d '\n' | base64)`
or explicitly do the username:password pattern: 
`printf ":%s" "$API_KEY" | tr -d '\n' | base64`
then curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Basic $AUTH_HEADER" ...`

sam_c: small gotcha for ruby -> Base64.encode64 vs strict_encode64 + for go/node differences: Node `Buffer.from(...).toString('base64')` and Go `base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString` don't insert newlines. Ruby's `encode64` wraps lines. So the bug surface differs by language.

alex: ran the hexdump — i had a 00 at the end (from an old windows tool that saved as UTF-16LE and my wrapper trimmed oddly). converted and replaced the secret in terraform, switched to strict_encode64 in the helper and curl to staging now returns 200. thanks! :tada:

ci-bot: deploy-hook: redeployed staging (alex/service) with new secret at 2026-03-17T15:41:24Z — tests green :white_check_mark:

maria.dev: nice — maybe add a tiny lint in the helper to use strict_encode64 by default, or a quick unit test that checks Authorization header length/format.

alex: yup will add a test. thanks all :)
